description: Comparison of LIMEN teleportation-circuit fidelity on ibm_kingston across two physical qubit mappings: q[10, 11, 12] vs q[10, 11, 18], sharing the state and Alice qubits but differing in the Bob relay qubit.
methodology: Fidelity estimated as fraction of shots where Bobs qubit (leftmost classical bit, c2) measures 0, matching the prepared |0> input state, per limen.quantum_channel.teleport_analysis.estimate_fidelity. Physical qubit layout and timestamps extracted from the IBM Runtime job object (job.inputs transpiled-circuit layout, job.metrics) via examples/fetch_qpu_job.py, not transcribed from screenshots.

comparison.interpretation: The q[10, 11, 12] layout outperforms q[10, 11, 18] by 1.6 percentage points (95.4% vs 93.8%), isolating the effect of Bob relay qubit choice on end-to-end teleportation fidelity while holding the state and Alice qubits fixed. Demonstrates LIMEN can certify protocol performance sensitivity to physical qubit mapping on real NISQ hardware.
